name: 浅V口运动乐福鞋

statement: 浅V鞋口接入织物舌片，让乐福鞋的穿入方式更有运动感。
detailBody: 取消硬币带，灰色舌片从鞋背开口露出；小徽记落在前缘。
prompt: Create ONE photorealistic footwear design master for MOVERNO, a premium dark youthful fashion label, feminine/unisex directional footwear, fashion product not office wear. Single complete shoe only, 3/4 outside view, toe left foreground and heel right background, modestly elevated camera to expose vamp and collar, product fills 85% of landscape 3:2 image, neutral light warm-grey seamless studio surface, clear soft contact shadow, disciplined cool softbox highlights, real textile weave and construction, detailed but natural. No human, no decorative scene, no caption or large typography, no box, no duplicate shoe. Brand input is AUTHENTIC MOVERNO emblem and wordmark: two slender mirrored blades with STRAIGHT VERTICAL OUTER EDGES and curved INNER tips, separated by open narrow central slit, never leaves or butterfly/X/M. Match supplied standard brand glyph where requested. Brand spelling MOVERNO, tiny refined serif wordmark. Never copy any competitor logo, side stripe or proprietary tread. No chunky dad shoe, segmented pods, long heel extension, plastic cages, huge platform, neon, cute bows, excess jewelry, office dress-shoe styling. The commercial product reference describes ONE research cue only, it is not the base shoe to rebrand. Design an original silhouette with the exact construction below. F05: a fashion sport-loafer hybrid, BLACK softly lustrous supple leather. MODERATELY wide truncated soft-square toe, visibly shallow/flattened forefoot (not huge), low continuous black rubber sole 12mm at forefoot and 18mm heel, NO discrete heel block, no penny saddle, no metal snaffle, no tassels. Shoe upper vamp uses a thin rounded-square apron STITCH line (not a bulky rolled moccasin welt), extending to a SHALLOW V-shaped front collar opening. A short, graphite-grey fine technical textile tongue insert sits FLUSH inside this shallow V; grey exposed triangle approx 25mm high, compact and not folded. Closed heel with very lightly padded low sport collar, lateral collar slightly dips just behind instep then returns to heel. Uninterrupted side surface only one slanting rear-quarter seam to avoid office formality. A 12mm high small smoke-silver exact MOVERNO twin-blade emblem inset in vamp immediately below the V apex; tiny tonal deboss MOVERNO on lateral rear midsole. Sole has restrained thin transverse microgrooves near ground line, quiet continuous profile. Fashion appeal from a flattened sport toe and open V rather than a bulbous smart loafer. Use reference3 NB only to understand sports-loafer hybrid logic; explicitly discard its penny strap, pod sole, tech overlays and all NB markings. Independent new form. Keep both sources of surface, satin-black leather and graphite knit tongue visible and authentic.
